Reviewing.

replies.author: Riskayyy
replies.body:
Hello again,
After a quick discussion with other moderators, it is conclusive that the accuse player - in this case Just4Alex - was not intentionally spawnblocking. 
a) the tunnel was at-least 20 blocks out from spawn, and I noticed other players sneaking around the end of it. 
b) Jack only placed a few blocks.

Additionally, no real harm was dealt.

Thank you for the report, we will keep a close eye on this player for you. Keep up the good work. 
Thanks,
Moderator Team.
